title: AutoNEAR · the agent with a company card (v2)

voice.name: Puck
voice.style: Confident, warm product-launch narration at a brisk pace of about three words per second, with crisp sentences and short natural pauses. Start intimate, gain energy through the owner flow, and become quiet and exact at each refusal.

tokens_note: Numbers only as {{tokens}} resolved from src/data/captured.json (and contracts.json). No typed digits in narration.

scenes.narration: Your phone lights up at midnight. Your new hire wants to spend. Would you hand them the company card?
scenes.style: Intimate and unhurried, slower than the rest at about two words per second; let the question hang.

scenes.narration: A public post looks useful. Hidden inside: an order to send the budget away. That is the trap.
scenes.style: Gather speed, then stop cold on the final sentence.

scenes.narration: Here is AutoNEAR. You choose what it watches. You set the card's limit, and you can stop it.
scenes.style: Warm and assured, with a clear pause after the product name.

scenes.narration: It reads public signals and shows its work. This snapshot has {{live.total|w}} records. One promising idea still gets a low-confidence warning.
scenes.style: Bright discovery, then measured caution on the warning.

scenes.narration: The council weighs the evidence. {{run.roleCount|W}} roles prepare a brief, check the build, and leave a request for the owner.
scenes.style: A little quicker, like a team working in sequence.

scenes.narration: The owner reviews the exact request and holds to approve. Approval is a decision. The next action still has to pass its checks.
scenes.style: Slow down; make the full stop after decision unmistakable.

scenes.narration: Now a result comes back with the wrong code. AutoNEAR refuses to record that deployment. The matching result passes.
scenes.style: Low and precise for the refusal; release the tension on passes.

scenes.tag: PUBLIC TESTNET · DEMO OWNER KEY · AUTOMATED
scenes.narration: This also ran on NEAR testnet. A demo owner capped a vault, the agent deployed through it, and the chain refused it {{testnet.refusalCount|w}} times when it pushed past its limits.
scenes.style: Steady and factual at about two and a half words per second; leave a clear pause after testnet.

scenes.narration: The agent has a company card. You set the limit. Judges: clone it and run the tests.
scenes.style: Land the first two sentences slowly, then invite action.
